_doc: SAMPLE small talk - the real pool (a few hundred lines) is not published. Made-up local chatter for 'what news' when no live deed is told. One line is picked per reply and the NPC tells it in their own words. {town} = the NPC's town, {near} = a neighbouring town. No named people; gender-neutral wording.
any: the price of bread in {town} went up again this week
a wagon bound for {near} broke an axle and blocked half the way
folk say the winter will come early this year
someone saw lights out on the water past {town} last night
the well by the market tastes of iron lately
a travelling tinker passed through, selling pots that leak
rain has turned the track toward {near} into soup
two merchants nearly came to blows over a bolt of cloth
the bells rang late for no reason anyone can name
crows keep gathering on the old mill roof

Britain: the castle guard changed its watch hours again
the bakers on the west side are feuding over a recipe
Minoc: the Minoc miners swear they hit something shiny down the east shaft
the tinkers are short of good iron
Yew: the woodcutters found wolf tracks near the abbey
the abbey brewed its best batch in years, the monks say
Trinsic: the paladins are drilling on the green every morning
Vesper: a barge ran aground under the east bridge
Zento: the tea house by the bridge has a new kettle and is very proud of it
